Powerful Blow.description: A committed strike that adds 5 damage to your attack.

Parry.description: Brace behind your weapon and reduce the next incoming attack by 5.

Magic Missile.description: Unerring arcane force deals 8 damage to your opponent, ignoring armor.

Mage Shield.description: A shimmering ward absorbs up to 6 damage.

Sneak Attack.description: Strike a weak point for double your normal damage.

Evade.description: Slip aside and avoid the next enemy attack entirely.

Cure Wounds.description: Channel divine power to recover 8 hit points.

Blessing.description: A brief blessing adds 2 to your next damage and wards off 2 damage from the next attack.

Fierce Attack.description: A powerful level-3 strike that adds 8 damage.

Multiattack.description: A level-5 flurry that deals double your normal damage.

Weapon Mastery.description: Level-7 mastery adds 3 damage and wards off 3 damage on the next exchange.

Fireball.description: A level-3 burst of flame deals 12 damage.

Teleport.description: A level-7 blink avoids the next enemy attack.

Backstab.description: A level-3 strike for triple your normal damage.

Evasion.description: Level-5 footwork reduces the next incoming attack by 8.

Poison Mastery.description: A level-7 venomous strike deals 9 damage.

Remove Curse.description: Level-3 divine light restores 5 hit points.

Divine Armor.description: Level-7 holy armor absorbs up to 10 damage.

Knock.description: Open a locked door or chest within two steps without needing its key.

Mage Hand.description: A spectral hand operates a door, chest or lever within two steps.

Guidance.description: Divine insight adds 2 to your next ability check.

Last Stand.description: A level-10 capstone: plant your feet and turn the next exchange in your favor. Adds 5 damage and prevents 5 damage.

Meteor Swarm.description: A level-10 capstone: call down a storm of falling stars for 30 damage that ignores armor.

Assassinate.description: A level-10 capstone: strike a lethal opening for four times your normal damage.

Divine Intervention.description: A level-10 capstone: a miracle of light restores 40 hit points.

Detect Magic.description: Sense magical auras nearby, revealing hidden magical traps and objects.

Disguise Self.description: Wear an illusory face and manner. Gain advantage on Stealth until you rest, and a one-use bluff in conversation.

Comprehend Languages.description: Read ancient script and inscriptions without a check.

Second Wind.description: Draw a deep breath and recover 10 hit points.

Shield Wall.description: Set your shield and reduce the next incoming hit by 8.

Scorching Ray.description: A searing ray deals a flat 10 damage.

Arcane Ward.description: A layered ward absorbs up to 10 damage.

Death Mark.description: Mark a weakness and add 8 damage to your next strike.

Misdirection.description: Mislead the enemy and avoid the next attack entirely.

War Blessing.description: A martial blessing adds 2 damage and wards off 3 damage.

Foresight.description: Read the next blow before it lands and avoid it.

Dragon Breath.description: Exhale draconic fire for a flat 14 damage.

Chaos Bolt.description: A wild bolt of magic deals a flat 12 damage.

Vicious Mockery.description: A cutting insult deals a flat 6 damage.

Healing Word.description: A word of encouragement restores 6 hit points.

Bardic Inspiration.description: Inspire yourself: +2 damage and +1 defense on the next exchange.

Dissonant Whispers.description: A discordant note deals a flat 10 damage.

Hypnotic Pattern.description: A twisting pattern turns the next attack aside.

Dimension Door.description: Step through a fold in space and avoid the next attack.

Power Word Stun.description: A word of command deals a flat 20 damage.

Cutting Words.description: A well-timed insult turns the next hit aside, reducing it by 6.

Combat Inspiration.description: A rallying phrase adds 2 damage and wards off 2 damage.

Eldritch Blast.description: A lance of force deals a flat 8 damage.

Hex.description: Curse a target, granting advantage on attacks against it for 3 turns.

Armor of Agathys.description: A cold ward absorbs up to 8 damage.

Misty Step.description: Step through the veil and avoid the next attack.

Hunger of Hadar.description: A void of cold and hunger deals a flat 12 damage.

Fear.description: Curse a target with fright for 2 turns.

Power Word Kill.description: A word of ending deals a flat 25 damage.

Hellish Rebuke.description: A burst of hellfire deals a flat 10 damage.

Psychic Lance.description: A lance of thought staggers a target for 1 turn.

Thorn Whip.description: A lash of thorns deals a flat 7 damage.

Entangle.description: Roots restrain a target for 2 turns.

Barkskin.description: Your hide hardens and absorbs up to 6 damage.

Moonbeam.description: A column of moonlight deals a flat 12 damage.

Call Lightning.description: A bolt of storm-light deals a flat 14 damage.

Wall of Thorns.description: A wall of thorns restrains a target for 2 turns.

Storm of Vengeance.description: A storm of raw nature deals a flat 25 damage.

Primal Strike.description: A primal blow deals a flat 12 damage.

Nature\u0027s Ward.description: A ward of living wood absorbs up to 8 damage.
